svg.text: Four-step snail cam: 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 / 2 mm drops, one per quarter turn
Red: each step's drop in mm. Dashed: the 12 mm dwell, and where the follower rests (1 mm above it).
Drawn the instant before the 2 mm drop. After each step the follower hangs clear of the cam.
The steps fix the drops' differences; the servo's
